compatibility.rule: Before the first stable release, fully evidenced Foundation Revision may correct the latest numbered structure while preserving published coordinates and lineage; Foundation Freeze then requires later substantive change to mint a new KFD.

contractWorld.compatibilityRule: Compatible additions may keep schemaVersion 1; semantic or required-field changes require a new interface version or contract.

witness.compatibilityRule: Compatible additions may keep schemaVersion 1; semantic or required-field changes require a new interface version or contract.

publicationUrlSemantics.compatibilityRule: Compatible additions may keep schemaVersion 1; semantic or required-field changes require a new interface version or contract.

candidateRegistry.compatibilityRule: Compatible additions may keep schemaVersion 1; changes to candidate identity, numbering allocation, slot binding, or promotion meaning require a new interface version or contract.

verificationBundle.compatibilityRule: Compatible additions may keep schemaVersion 1; path-safety, canonicalization, required-input, or kind changes require a new interface version or contract.

verificationReport.compatibilityRule: Compatible additions may keep schemaVersion 1; validity, qualification, check, issue, or responsibility meaning changes require a new interface version or contract.

agentHubManifest.compatibilityRule: The alpha profile is selected only by exact version and manifest digest; changed required semantics, authority, operations, failure meaning, or rooted surfaces require a new incompatible profile version.

agentHubCapabilities.compatibilityRule: Compatible optional features may be added only when unselected by default and safely preservable; new required features or changed negotiation meaning require a new interface version or contract.

agentHubExchange.compatibilityRule: Changes to identity, authority, causal roots, disclosure, idempotency, receiver verdict, admission, conflict, or completion meaning require a new incompatible profile or interface version.

concepts.foundationRevision: fully evidenced pre-stable correction of the latest numbered foundation

concepts.receiverVerdict: receiver-owned semantic assessment distinct from transport delivery
concepts.selectiveDisclosure: typed partial or redacted replication with retained uncertainty

kfd-4.title: Views must remain bound to declared perspectives

compatibility.rule: Before the first stable release, maintainer-authorized semantic refinement must declare breaking decision-surface impact; after stable, substantive change mints a new KFD.

observerPerspective.compatibilityRule: Compatible additions may keep schemaVersion 1; semantic or required-field changes require a new interface version or contract.

perspectiveReplay.compatibilityRule: Compatible additions may keep schemaVersion 1; semantic or required-field changes require a new interface version or contract.

kfd-5.label: KFD-5
kfd-5.title: Primitive discovery must separate genesis from qualification

compatibility.rule: Before the first stable release, maintainer-authorized semantic refinement must declare breaking decision-surface impact; after stable, substantive change mints a new KFD.

primitiveDiscovery.compatibilityRule: Version 3 requires perspective-declared, method-plural genesis and separates candidate generation from fact-bound qualification; further semantic or required-field changes require a new interface version or contract.

liveCaseRegistry.compatibilityRule: Version 2 preserves stable live-case identity and genesis, gives the case an independent active/closed/archived lifecycle, and requires one or more independently qualified candidate tracks with their own qualification status, claim boundary, and immutable current cut. Optional qualification arguments may be added without changing candidate status. Semantic, required-field, status-meaning, candidate-track, or identity changes require a new interface version or contract.

concepts.primitiveDiscoveryCase: stable live discovery case that may preserve and qualify multiple candidate tracks
concepts.candidateTrack: independently named and qualified Primitive candidate within a live case
concepts.ontologySplit: preserved transition from a fused candidate boundary to independently qualified candidate tracks
concepts.distinguishabilityArgument: conditional deletion argument for decision-relevant information dimensions without a universality or implementation-shape claim

kfd-6.label: KFD-6
kfd-6.title: Autonomous discovery must remain grounded in causal experience

compatibility.rule: Before the first stable release, maintainer-authorized semantic refinement must declare breaking decision-surface impact; after stable, substantive change mints a new KFD.

autonomousDiscoveryLoop.compatibilityRule: Draft interface v4 requires method-plural generation experiments, bounded method comparison, and a conditional boundary hypothesis; further semantic or required-field changes require a new interface version or contract.

kfd-7.label: KFD-7
kfd-7.title: Real-world action must keep its responsibilities distinct

compatibility.rule: Foundation Revision 6 preserves published coordinates while correcting the model from five peer responsibilities to two Fact-Episode ontology bindings plus three Action Geometry Primitive mappings. The retained actionContract schemaVersion 2 roles[] field remains readable with the same five values and no prior root is reinterpreted. Compatible draft Domain Profile additions may keep that interface identity. Action Profile and unqualified Action Contract are compatibility-only terms; new authoring uses Fact-Episode Ontology, Action Geometry, Domain Profile, Action Geometry Contract, and Domain Profile Declaration. Changes to ontology or geometry responsibility, theorem applicability, transition validity, prohibited inference, evidence closure, activation meaning, or required fields require a new interface version or explicit Foundation Revision. After stable, substantive decision change mints a new KFD.

actionContract.compatibilityRule: This retained actionContract identity declares two Fact-Episode ontology bindings and three Action Geometry Primitive mappings for a Domain Profile; its roles[] field and five closed values remain compatibility coordinates and do not identify the future Action Geometry Contract. Compatible Domain Profile-owned lifecycle additions may keep schemaVersion 2. New authoring uses the canonical Domain Profile Declaration term. Semantic or required-field changes to ontology or geometry responsibility, theorem applicability, transition, evidence, non-claim, or activation meaning require a new interface version or contract.

surfaces.description: Commit-addressed cross-product qualification and activation evidence for KFD-7.
surfaces.weldRationale: Consumers can distinguish structural schema validity from retained Domain Profile qualification, product availability, independent review, and the KFD-level activation verdict.

impactProjection.breaking: Incompatible changes to the evidence contract or activation meaning require an explicit compatibility action before a dependent gate may pass.
impactProjection.additive: Additional product witnesses or compatible evidence fields must preserve prior coordinates and claim boundaries.
impactProjection.none: Changes outside this registered evidence surface do not change its KFD-7 activation cut.
impactProjection.unclassifiable: If evidence impact cannot be classified, activation must fail closed until the surface register is repaired.

surfaces.description: Human-readable qualification cut, evidence boundary, and non-claims for KFD-7 activation.
surfaces.weldRationale: Humans and agents receive the same product coordinates, decision boundary, and non-claims as the machine evidence record.

impactProjection.breaking: A conflicting or weaker activation boundary requires correction before a dependent gate may pass.
impactProjection.additive: Compatible clarification may extend the guide without changing the retained machine verdict.
impactProjection.none: Editorial changes that preserve the machine record and claim boundary do not change activation semantics.
impactProjection.unclassifiable: If the guide and machine evidence cannot be reconciled, activation must fail closed.

concepts.atlas: addressable action perspective and accepted fact cut
concepts.authorityBoundary: independently derivable and revocable action boundary
concepts.factEpisodeOntology: canonical contract-world distinction between admitted state and realized causal occurrence
concepts.ontologyBinding: Domain Profile declaration that binds a domain representation to Fact or Episode semantics
concepts.actionPrimitiveMapping: Domain Profile declaration that maps a domain representation to Pursuit, Atlas, or Warrant
concepts.actionGeometry: canonical three-coordinate cross-domain responsibility model over the Fact-Episode Ontology
concepts.actionGeometryContract: canonical machine artifact that identifies Action Geometry and its invariants
concepts.targetRelation: directional relation over reachable fact cuts
concepts.validActionSet: intersection of supported, advancing, and authorized actions
concepts.counterfactualIndependence: role independence tested by controlled variation
concepts.explicitAdmission: separate admission of successor facts after occurrence
concepts.progressiveDisclosure: low-friction interface that preserves inspectable responsibility
concepts.conservativeSessionLimit: lossless session-compatible projection for bounded low-complexity work
concepts.complexityBreakpoint: condition that makes an independent action responsibility decision-relevant and addressable
concepts.decisionObservationalEquivalence: componentwise preservation of direction, perspective boundary, effective authority, causal process, and admitted result
concepts.sessionRoundTripTheorem: conditional preservation theorem for session expansion and projection
concepts.contextInsufficiency: same-payload counterexample showing that context alone cannot determine the valid action set
concepts.actionProfile: compatibility-only metadata term for a Domain Profile declaration; deprecated for new authoring and not an Action Primitive
concepts.actionContract: compatibility-only version 2 interface identity for a Domain Profile declaration; not the future Action Geometry Contract
concepts.domainProfile: versioned adopter declaration of how one domain inhabits the Action Geometry
concepts.domainProfileDeclaration: canonical machine artifact that maps one adopter to Action Geometry
concepts.roleIndependence: semantic distinguishability and traceability independent of physical component count
concepts.semanticRoleDistinguishability: counterfactual and fail-visible separation of responsibility mappings even when physically co-located
concepts.profileLifecycleVocabulary: legacy metadata term for Domain Profile-owned lifecycle vocabulary
concepts.roleDeletionExperiment: compatibility evidence category for semantic role deletion or fusion; not a physical-layout test
concepts.activationDecision: activate, revise, reject, or pending verdict
concepts.qualificationCut: exact evidence cut and independent review binding
concepts.profileRefinementWitness: evidence that a concrete Domain Profile refines the standard session theorem
